evals.prompt: Make an interactive HTML map of our billing services that I can click through to see each worker's retry rules and follow how an order event moves upstream and downstream.
Build an HTML explainer of our 35-node data pipeline where new engineers can pan and zoom around, click a job to read its inputs and outputs in a drawer, and highlight everything connected to it.
I want a single-file web page showing our checkout, fraud, and ledger subsystems as grouped boxes I can zoom into and explore hop by hop.
Create an explorable architecture page for the webhook router with stage lanes from intake to delivery, where clicking any service lights up its call path and shows its runbook notes.
Turn our dependency graph of 25 microservices and queues into an offline HTML artifact I can pan, zoom, and click to inspect each service's upstream callers and downstream dependencies.
Make an HTML runbook page with an interactive topology diagram of our regional caches, databases, and workers so on-call can click a failing node and trace every affected path.
Show our event-driven fulfillment flow on a companion screen as an interactive graph I can pan and click through to inspect each queue and worker before we pick a design.
Build an HTML page that maps how customer events flow across our analytics collectors, Kafka topics, and warehouse tables, with clickable nodes that open each table's schema notes.
Add a simple static flowchart of the 4-step login redirect check to this HTML report.
Include a sequence diagram showing the OAuth token exchange between the browser, the auth server, and the API gateway on the HTML explainer page.
Draw a state chart of an order's lifecycle (draft, pending, paid, refunded, voided) in the HTML page.
Put a small static diagram of the three-box retry loop in the report page; nobody needs to click or zoom it.
Write a diagram of the retry flow for this README in Markdown.
Add an entity-relationship diagram of the users, subscriptions, and charges tables to the HTML design write-up.
Show a quick static Mermaid diagram on the companion screen using the diagram field to illustrate the two-step approval sequence.
Include a class diagram of the parser interfaces in our HTML technical overview.

Build an HTML page that walks support agents through our refund approval as a flowchart: a decision for amounts over $500, a retry if the bank rejects the payout, and each branch clickable for the policy notes.

Make a single-file HTML explainer of our webhook delivery flowchart where a failed delivery loops back through exponential backoff, and the 'escalate to a human' step opens its own separate flowchart.
Add a flowchart to this HTML onboarding guide that asks 'Is the account verified?' and 'Is the plan paid?', with labelled yes and no exits, and a node for the KYC sub-process that readers can open.
Add a flowchart of the retry-then-give-up logic to the README for the payments package.
Draw the deploy approval process as a flowchart with yes/no decisions inside this Markdown design doc.
Put a flowchart with a decision and a retry loop for the nightly import job in our docs/runbook.md.
Put an ER diagram of the orders and customers tables in the project README.
Add a class diagram of the plugin interfaces I can click through to the HTML architecture page.
Build an HTML page that shows how checkout, the payment service, and the ledger call each other when a customer pays, with replies and an async webhook at the end.
Make a web page for the on-call runbook with a sequence diagram of the cache-miss path between the client, the API, the cache, and the database, including an alt for hit versus miss.
Create an HTML explainer of our login handshake as a sequence diagram where I can step through the request payload at each message.
Show the order fulfillment calls between the storefront, the order service, and the warehouse on an HTML page, with a loop that polls for shipment status.
Add a sequence diagram to this HTML design review showing the retry protocol between the worker and the queue, with an opt block for the dead-letter hop and a par block for the two notifications.
On the companion screen, draw who calls whom during the subscription renewal, as a sequence diagram I can play through one message at a time.
Add a sequence diagram of the OAuth token exchange to the README for the auth package.
Include a sequence diagram of the webhook delivery calls in this Markdown design doc.
Draw a state chart of the subscription lifecycle (active, paused, cancelled, expired) on the HTML report page.
